name: Bruckberg (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, white and black, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Bruckberg (a white antler with roses on blue under a chequy chief).
history: Municipal flag of Bruckberg; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Bruckberg arms — antler with roses on blue
